blocks.text: South Korean actress Kim Yong-ji surprised fans after revealing her recent wedding to her partner, during which she also reportedly announced her pregnancy. Yong-ji showed moments from the intimate ceremony through her Instagram page on Tuesday, Oct. 13. “I’m now married. Thank you for congratulating me,” she said in Korean. View this post on Instagram A post shared by 김용지 (@demi_kimee) Among those present at the event were Yong-ji’s “Tale of the Nine Tailed” co-stars Lee Dong-wook, Kim Bum, Ryu Kyung-soo and Hwang Hee.
